episodes.title: Episode 1
episodes.summary: Shardlake travels to Scarnsea to begin his investigation into a brutal murder at a remote monastery.

episodes.title: Episode 2
episodes.summary: Shardlake hears a shocking allegation that incriminates Cromwell, and could put himself in danger.

episodes.title: Episode 3
episodes.summary: Another death leads Shardlake to a gruesome discovery, changing the course of the investigation.

episodes.title: Episode 4
episodes.summary: Shardlake feels the wrath of Cromwell, but he returns in hope that he may finally unravel the truth.
